after.expiration_note: Valid 365 days from issuance for awards issued on or after January 1, 2027. An award issued earlier keeps the expiry date shown in your account.

changes.summary: Updated to the 2027 Milestone Rewards chart, including the new award validity period.

after.title: 150 Nights Choice - Delta SkyMiles Platinum Medallion Status
after.description: Second choice (pick one): Delta SkyMiles Platinum Medallion status (without Choice Benefits) in the member's own SkyMiles account. No added benefit if the member already holds that status or higher, or chooses it more than once in a Medallion qualification year.
after.expiration_note: The status lasts as long as Medallion status earned in the SkyMiles qualification period in which the milestone is reached, not when the award is selected.
after.notes: Requires linked World of Hyatt and Delta SkyMiles accounts.
